games.name: Xmas Squad
games.description: Physics co-op comedy for up to 4 players: deliver presents, steal cookies and save your friends from monsters. One more house and we're outta here. Promise.

games.name: Idiots 4 Order
games.description: Swipe deliveries, scream directions, juggle pizzas and drive like a maniac in this chaotic 2-4 player co-op delivery game. One moped, 4 idiots, infinite chaos.

games.name: Spray Days
games.description: Paint, restore, and customize worn-out objects in this satisfying spray painting simulator. Complete quirky commissions, upgrade your tools, expand your workshop, and grow your restoration business - solo or with friends in online co-op!

games.name: Bird Poo Game
games.description: Cause chaos from the sky and profit underground. Drop poop on pedestrians to send them rushing to Bob's laundromat. Collect coins, upgrade machines, unlock explosive abilities, and build a bizarre laundry empire one splat at a time.

games.name: Radioactivity
games.description: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

games.name: OnlyCats
games.description: Pet cats, earn love, buy more cats. OnlyCats is a cozy incremental idle game where hovering over adorable pixel cats fills your coin and love stash. Unlock new cats, grow your collection, and discover more upgrades.

games.name: Welcome Back to Aeris
games.description: Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the strange traces appearing beyond the screen.

games.name: Incremental Garden
games.description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

games.name: Knights vs. Dinosaurs
games.description: An isometric co-op action romp: charge in as a knight — or a kangaroo — against hordes of hungry dinosaurs. Explore a farm overworld and procedural dungeons, smash barrels for chocolate coins, gear up in the shop, and topple bosses in online co-op. Fast, chaotic, gleefully absurd.

games.name: 5-Star Taxi
games.description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

games.name: One Last Draw
games.description: One Last Draw is a thrilling roguelike card game: HIT or STAND? Keep drawing to boost your score, earn money, and discover powerful Cards, Chips, and Items. But the more you draw, the greater the chance of hitting a Bomb Card and losing everything. Score enough to advance!

games.name: Over Package!
games.description: Over Package! is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer party game. Clash with your friends in hilarious arena brawls to deliver cargo. Outsmart rivals with dynamic environmental destruction, leverage chaotic physics, and turn every delivery into absolute combat logistics madness!

games.name: Let's make SILLY ART!
games.description: Time to make SILLY ART! Help Charlie rediscover the joy of making art in this cozy and creative point and click. Tidy your house, find inspirations, collect stickers and create authentic artwork to build your portfolio!

games.name: Juicy Fugitives
games.description: Hunt down the most wanted fruits in this cartoon third-person shooter. Play as a pirate crew framed by a mysterious fire, blast through waves of enemies across 5 kingdoms, and survive slapstick boss fights, solo or in 3 player online co-op.

games.name: Squabblin Goblins
games.description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.

games.name: Concerto on White: Bass Hero
games.description: Pick up your keyboard and play it like a real bass! Take on the role of Ostinata, the leader and bassist of the all-girl band Tutti Nova. Strengthen the bonds among the five band members while staying ever ready to fend off bassist jokes, and grow your fan base to perform in larger venues!

games.name: Unheenged
games.description: Unheenged is a cooperative horror extraction game for you and up to 3 friends. featuring proximity voice chat, scary monsters, multiple items and doors... Lots of doors.

games.name: Winds of Bounty
games.description: Winds of Bounty is a casual, fast-paced single and network multi player, competitive sailing exploration and treasure hunting game, featuring multiple game modes, including Treasure Hunt, Monster Hunt, Orb Hunt, Race, Arena, and Treasure Gallery!

games.name: Black Hole Idle
games.description: Start as a tiny black hole and grow by consuming asteroids, planets, and star systems. Automate your power, unlock upgrades, and devour the universe in this relaxing space idle incremental game.

games.name: Freshly Caught
games.description: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. 🎣 Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

games.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator
games.description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

games.name: Mini Sushi Factory
games.description: Build your own sushi factory in this cozy automation game. Unlock new ingredients, buy new recipes and upgrade food machinery to feed the Yōkai with food they love.

games.name: Tiny Taxi
games.description: Drift, drive and survive in a top-down pixel art city! Pick up passengers with strange demands, earn cash to upgrade your taxi and choose curses that make every run tougher. Customize your cab/driver, build your mixtape and climb the leaderboard.

games.name: Synapse Idle
games.description: Grow a 3D neural network from a single neuron. Workers haul energy along radiant paths, buildings amplify every passing signal, and a 100-node skill tree reshapes how your synapse evolves. A calm, incremental idle game about watching complexity bloom — tinted in whatever colors you choose.

games.name: Mind The Gap
games.description: Mind The Gap is a puzzle platformer game where you and your unlikely companion work together to create your own path to freedom. Featuring 80+ handcrafted levels, unique bosses, and hidden collectables, each stage introduces new mechanics that push your abilities further.

games.name: Fluffy Spider
games.description: A fluffy spider. Tricky jumps. A web to call home. Explore a colourful 2D platformer, find secret worlds, then build a network of insect traps in your idle hub. Collect silk, unlock talents and characters, and fill your radio with original songs.

games.name: Brawling Beetles
games.description: Die. Adapt. Fight Back. In this faced-paced top down multiplayer beetle brawler, every death makes you stronger. Choose between abilites, classes and weapons. Battle in matches with up to 4 players, fight PvE enemies, collect loot, and unleash powerful ultimates to claim victory.

games.name: Kādomon: Incremental Eclipse
games.description: Build a team of Kādomon that fights for you, then push deeper. An Idle Incremental RPG where your creatures auto-battle through endless waves, each with their own skill tree to master. Eclipse your run to unlock permanent power and climb further than ever before.

games.name: HUSH
games.description: A co-op horror game where you and your friends break into monsters’ homes and wreck their stuff. Smash everything you can and escape the crime scene before they catch you — they hear every sound.

games.name: Thieving Together
games.description: You and your crew have one goal: break in, grab everything, and get out before sunrise. Thieving Together is a chaotic physics PvP & co-op heist party game. Drag loot, dodge rivals, stack the van fast. Everything wobbles. Everyone steals. Biggest haul by sunrise wins.

games.name: Runemoria - Blades of Memory
games.description: Flip cards, uncover pairs, and command your squad in a tactical memory RPG. Equip weapons, unlock powerful skills, and battle enemies or other players in strategic single-player and PvP combat.

games.name: Lines Must Cross
games.description: Lines Must Cross is an incremental graph game about firing mathematical functions and earning progress when they intersect. Click to spawn lines, unlock new function types, and grow a living coordinate system.

games.name: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
games.description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

games.name: Mine or Burn
games.description: Start with a basic mining ship and snowball into an asteroid-crushing powerhouse in this incremental bullet hell roguelite. Mine asteroids, battle rival miners, stack upgrades, create powerful builds, and survive escalating threats across dangerous star systems.

games.name: Particle Collectotron
games.description: Click and collect energy in this short, active incremental. Upgrade your reactor, tune injector payload and trajectories, unlock exotic matter, and push the experiment past its limits.

games.name: Catching Breaks
games.description: Catching Breaks is a darkly comedic office simulator where fixing problems is easy and dealing with people is not. Repair broken machines while coworkers interrupt you with pointless conversations, fake urgency, and corporate nonsense. Keep the office running long enough to survive another workday.

games.name: Zombie Industrial Complex
games.description: Exterminate zombies using the might of the military industrial complex. In this active incremental game, you'll earn money by defeating zombies which can be used to buy weapons, purchase upgrades, call in airstrikes, and send in the tanks!

games.name: StoryMode
games.description: StoryMode is a reading tool completely built around idle/incremental gameplay and progression. Add manga and books, earn experience, levels, and rewards as you read. Complete quests, discover companions, and personalize your reading experience with customizable themes and animated backgrounds.

games.name: Pumpkin Is Yummy!?
games.description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

games.name: Pakku Pony
games.description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

games.name: Captain Speedfin
games.description: Captain Speedfin is stuck with an hourglass and needs to be fast! Race against the clock through 60 challenging levels of pirate parkour, where every second counts. Grab your treasure and get out before time runs out!

games.name: Wander Her Way VR
games.description: Explore incredible interactive locations with your gorgeous companion. A sandbox VR experience with mini-games. Shoot enemies, destroy objects, drive a car, dance with an amazing girl, defend a tower, catch mischievous kittens, watch a fireworks show. Realistic female character, advanced physics

games.name: Joaquin Simulator
games.description: Help retiree Joaquin on his road trip through Brazil. It's a 2000 km journey full of challenges, and nothing is simple in Brazil. You must eat, drink, smoke, earn money, deal with corrupt cops, all to reach a party to save democracy in Brazil.

games.name: Mech Assembler: Model Kit builder Simulator
games.description: Welcome to Mech Assembler, a relaxing puzzle game inspired by model kit (Gunpla) construction. You'll experience the relaxing process of building a model. Once assembled, you can paint it with Spry. Earn points based on your accuracy and unlock new elements.

games.name: Burger Rush Simulator
games.description: Burger Rush Simulator is a fast food simulator where you manage your fast food restaurant, order supplies, restock containers, take payments at checkout and drive-thru, prepare meals, hire staff, expand your kitchen and dining area, and unlock features like storage and touchscreen checkout.

games.name: Marble Run Maker
games.description: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions.

games.name: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
games.description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

games.name: Shenanigans Party
games.description: A chaotic free-for-all party brawler for up to 16 players. Shove, launch and dash rivals off the map across a dozen fast-paced minigames, then roll the dice on the party board between rounds. Cute characters, absurd chaos, zero mercy. Solo with bots or online.

games.name: Amara
games.description: Manage and grow your cozy café from scratch in a world full of adorable talking cats. Craft authentic coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques, upgrade your shop, serve your fluffy customers, and become beloved by all.

games.name: RETROBOTS
games.description: The year is 2109, and RETROBOTS is the world's most chaotic sport. Select your Retrobot, customize and tune it to perfection, and enter the battle. Smash, slam, launch, and destroy your opponents in arenas across the world. Are you ready to KICK SOME BOT?

games.name: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
games.description: Build and run your own bakery in space as orders start stacking up. Keep the machines moving, prepare sweet treats, manage your robot helpers, and turn your little shop into the galaxy’s busiest bakery — solo or with friends.

games.name: Fearless Crew
games.description: Fearless Crew is a monster-hunter co-op game where you and up to 3 friends hunt monsters and bring them back to the ship. Each monster is caught in a unique way, with different tools - so be smart about what items you use and when. Even you might get caught off guard by the very tools you use

games.name: DeckDEX - TCG Live Simulator
games.description: Buy low, read the room, flip it. DeckDEX is a card-flipping market tycoon: hunt underpriced cards on a live player economy, rip packs, forge duplicates into rarities, complete sets, and build a cardboard empire.

games.name: Athletics 99
games.description: Run! Jump! Throw! Compete in the Athletics World Cup through 18 different events, and represent your country against worldwide athletes. Who knows, you might even break some World Records...

games.name: Islandustry
games.description: Find the best island, outbid your rivals and start exploiting it. Automate your production and watch the market to sell your goods at the right price. Use your profits to buy upgrades and make your production chain even faster.

games.name: Slimazing
games.description: Kill slimes. Collect juice. Upgrade your power. Craft potions and defeat elites and bosses in this juicy incremental roguelite.

games.name: Motorsport Park Manager
games.description: Build and customize your own motorsports park in this classic tycoon simulation. Start with local go-kart tracks and grassroots circuits, and grow into a world-renowned racing destination.

games.name: Red & Blue
games.description: Play as two housecats causing chaos while their owners are gone! Jump on each other, get chained to each other, and help each other solve color-coded puzzles.

games.name: Dyping Working: Task Manager
games.description: I, here on the screen, will monitor your work for you. Your work will progress smoothly. If you don't stay focused, I might just play a trick on you. But if you do concentrate... there might be a reward.

games.name: Beyond the Bars
games.description: Play as a prisoner, guard, or warden. Scheme, trade, and betray, or lock everything down. In this multiplayer social game of control and escape. The prison is yours to use… or break out of.
